specs.Picture Quality Enhancement Technology: HDR, Wide Color Gamut, Adaptive Sync

features: 23.8" FULL HD IPS DISPLAY: 1920 x 1080 resolution with 178° wide viewing angles, 99% sRGB coverage and 16.7 million colors for sharp, vivid, consistent visuals from any seat. The anti-glare screen cuts distracting reflections.
240Hz REFRESH RATE & 0.5ms MPRT: Get smooth, fluid motion with minimal blur for fast-paced esports and action games. Adjustable response time modes range from 4ms (Level 1) to 1ms (Level 4).

AMD FreeSync PREMIUM & HDR10: Syncs the monitor with your graphics card to reduce stutter and screen tearing. HDR10 support adds richer contrast and highlight detail in compatible content, with 300 nits brightness and 1000:1 contrast
FULLY ADJUSTABLE STAND: Tilt (-5° to +22°), swivel 30° left and right, adjust height up to 135mm, or rotate to portrait mode to fit your setup and posture

EYE COMFORT & CONNECTIVITY: TÜV Rheinland Eyesafe Display 2.0 certification and Low Blue Light technology for long sessions. Connect consoles and PCs through 2x HDMI and 1x DisplayPort, and fine-tune settings with Lenovo Artery software
Included components: Monitor with stand, 1x HDMI 2.0 cable (1.8m), 1x Power cable (1.8m), 4x Screws, Quick setup guide, Warranty booklet
